parameters.name: CycleTimeZone
parameters.description:
The time zone.

Example: +08:00

Valid values: -12:59 to +13:00

parameters.name: CycleType
parameters.description:
The aggregation period. If you do not specify this parameter, the system queries the details.

Valid values:

- Year

- Month

- Day

- All

parameters.name: Dimension
parameters.description:
The name of the dimension. This corresponds to the GROUP BY clause in SQL.

Valid values:

- UserId

- ServiceId

- ServiceVersion

- ServiceInstanceId

- DeploySucceeded

- ErrorType

- ErrorCode

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description:
The end of the time range to query.

Use UTC+0 time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description:
The name of the filter. This corresponds to the WHERE clause in SQL.

Valid values:

- UserId

- ServiceId

- ServiceVersion

- ServiceInstanceId

- DeploySucceeded (The value can be True or False. The value is case-insensitive.)

- ErrorType

- ErrorCode

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to start the next query.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the instance.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description:
The start of the time range to query.

Use UTC+0 time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format.
